content:
All requested game design documents have been successfully updated:
1. **01-game-design-document.md**: Integrated all new features (Daily Bonus replacing Energy, Royal Decree, Kingdom Defense, Discovery Book, Perfect Dodge, Friend Visits replacing Guilds).
2. **03-game-systems.md**: Simplified elements to 3 types, detailed the Perfect Dodge mechanics, Discovery Book, and the new daily/weekly systems.
3. **05-monetization.md**: Completely removed the energy system and tickets, added the "Royal Supplies" package, emphasized Battle Pass (45%), and updated the ARPDAU calculation.
4. **04-ui-ux-guide.md**: Updated color palette, added sound design section, updated UI screens to remove energy and include Discovery Book and Royal Decree.
5. **README.md**: Updated the game description and core features to highlight the unlimited play and the new meta systems.

All instructions were fully applied!
